Name: Ser Andrew Estermont
Quirks: speaks with the careful loyalty of a man who serves a kinsman not merely a lord
is uncomfortable with Melisandre in a way he does not know how to express to Stannis
CharacterDescription: Ser Andrew Estermont is a knight from House Estermont and son of Ser Lomas Estermont. He served as one of Stannis Baratheon's bannermen through the connection of the Estermont family to the Baratheons - Lord Steffon Baratheon's mother was an Estermont, making Andrew a distant cousin of Stannis. He is a capable Stormlands knight loyal to Stannis Baratheon with the specific loyalty of someone who serves a kinsman rather than merely an overlord. He has been at Dragonstone watching Melisandre's influence grow with the discomfort of a man who was raised in the Faith of the Seven.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Ser Andrew Estermont is a knight from House Estermont and son of Ser Lomas Estermont. Ser Andrew served as Stannis Baratheon's former squire.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Dragonstone with Stannis two days before Ned Stark's execution.
